title: Implement an arithmetic expression evaluator
description: calckit.evaluate.evaluate(expr) must parse and evaluate an arithmetic expression string supporting +, -, *, /, parentheses, correct operator precedence, unary minus, unary plus (a leading or post-operator '+' is a no-op sign, symmetric with unary minus), integer and float literals, and arbitrary whitespace. A malformed or invalid expression string (an unsupported/unexpected character, mismatched or extra parentheses, trailing tokens left over after a complete expression has already been parsed, or a missing operand such as a trailing operator) must raise ValueError rather than raising any other exception type, hanging, or silently returning a result for input that is not a valid expression. The current implementation is a stub. Implement a real recursive-descent (or shunting-yard) parser in calckit/evaluate.py. Do NOT use eval(). Do not modify any test files.
